tokens.name: moona-void
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every Moona surface starts here; the system has no light theme.

tokens.name: moona-void-2
tokens.usage: Raised surface on moona-void: panels, frames, cards, marquee tiles.

tokens.name: moona-scrim
tokens.usage: Over media: chip and control backgrounds that must read on any video frame.

tokens.name: moona-overlay
tokens.usage: Lightbox backdrop behind an opened film.

tokens.name: moona-ice
tokens.usage: The voice of the interface: accents, rules, progress line, nav underline. Reads on moona-void and moona-void-2.

tokens.name: moona-ice-hot
tokens.usage: Brightest text: headlines, button labels, primary copy on moona-void and moona-void-2.

tokens.name: moona-ice-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels: nav links, sub-lines, timestamps on moona-void.

tokens.name: moona-ice-faint
tokens.usage: Inactive borders, e.g. the round header buttons. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: moona-line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections and card borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: moona-body-dim
tokens.usage: Long-form body copy and section notes on moona-void.

tokens.name: moona-ice-mute
tokens.usage: Documents (briefs, quotes): secondary text, notes and card body, set in Assistant 300 on moona-void and moona-void-2.

tokens.name: moona-line-doc
tokens.usage: Documents: section dividers and card borders on brief pages. Decorative only.

tokens.name: moona-gold
tokens.usage: The one accent that acts: CTA ramp, focus rings, eyebrows, progress, rails. Never a second accent beside it.

tokens.name: moona-gold-hot
tokens.usage: Emphasis inside display headlines (the em in a SectionHeading title).

tokens.name: moona-gold-ink
tokens.usage: Text on gold and on the white CTA pill.

tokens.name: moona-gold-line
tokens.usage: Gold hairline border: IconButton, focus box around FileDrop.

tokens.name: moona-gold-wash
tokens.usage: Gold tint fill: round-button hover, FileDrop icon well.

tokens.name: moona-gold-wash-hot
tokens.usage: Gold tint on hover: MailButton, IconButton, FileDrop Browse.

tokens.name: moona-danger
tokens.usage: The only status colour: form errors and a rejected file chip. Pair it with words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: color-1
tokens.usage: CTA border ramp, stop 1: deep amber. Used only inside Button.

tokens.name: color-2
tokens.usage: CTA border ramp, stop 2: dark copper. Used only inside Button.

tokens.name: color-3
tokens.usage: CTA border ramp, stop 3: gold. Used only inside Button.

tokens.name: color-4
tokens.usage: CTA border ramp, stop 4: champagne. Used only inside Button.

tokens.name: color-5
tokens.usage: CTA border ramp, stop 5: honey. Used only inside Button.
